gateSemantics.rule: Every active page must have an exact displayed-text hash, image path, image-file hash and approved/replace decision. Any changed text, path or image bytes invalidate this audit record and require re-audit.

method: Loaded the merged runtime guided-reading manifest after all Story Bible rewrite registries were active.
Rendered all 1,861 active page images into 206 book contact sheets with the exact runtime displayed text directly beneath each image.

Visually inspected every page for exact action/subject/number/place/prop alignment, within-book continuity, canon character identity and scale, science accuracy, safety and animal welfare, and embedded generated text or symbols.
Marked replace only where a concrete visible contradiction, omission, continuity break, factual/safety defect or embedded-text defect was present.
